frontmatter.title: State vs Refs in React: Understanding Their Roles and Uses
frontmatter.subheading: Managing Data Flow and UI in React Applications
frontmatter.excerpt: Dive deep into the world of React and explore the differences between state and refs. Learn how to effectively use state for UI-driven values and refs for direct DOM access and interacting with browser APIs, optimizing the performance and functionality of your React applications.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
